    <div class="ln__price<% if (data.hasTabs) { %> ln__price--tabs<% } %>">
        <% if (data.hasTabs) { %>
            <ul class="ln__price__tabs">
                <% for (var i = 0; i < data.tabs.length; i++) { %>
                    <% if (data.labels.hasOwnProperty(data.tabs[i])) { %>
                        <li<% if (i === 0) { %> class="ln__price__tab__active js-tab-active"<% } %>>
                            <a href="#" data-price-id="<%= data.tabs[i] %>" class="js-tab-link">
                            <%= data.labels[data.tabs[i]] %>
                            </a>
                        </li>
                    <% } %>
                <% } %>
                <li>
                    <a href="#" class="js-more-tabs">+</a>
                </li>
            </ul>
            <ul class="ln__price__more__tabs js-more-tabs-container hidden"></ul>
        <% } %>
        <div class="ln__price__offers<% if (data.hasTabs) { %> ln__price__offers--tabs<% } %> js-price-offers">
            <div class="ln__price__head"></div>
            <ul>
                <% for (var i = 0; i < data.offers.length; i++) { %>
                <li<% if (i === 0) { %> class="ln__price__offers__item--is-highlight"<% } %><% if (i > 5) { %> class="hidden"<% } %>>
                    <a href="<%= data.offers[i].trackingUrl %>"
                       target="_blank"
                       title="<%= data.offers[i].productName %>"
                       class="js-price-lead js-track-price-url"
                       data-track-action="<%= data.offers[i].merchantName %>"
                       data-track-label="<%= data.productName %>"
                       rel="nofollow"
                    >
                        <div class="ln__price__offers__merchant">
                            <img src="<%= data.offers[i].merchantIcon %>" width="16" height="16" alt="" />
                            <%= data.offers[i].merchantName %>
                            <br />
                            <span class="ln__price__offers__merchant__shipping">
                                <% if (!data.offers[i].hasShippingInfo) { %>
                                    Livraison NC
                                <% } else if (parseFloat(data.offers[i].shipping.replace(',', '.')) > 0) { %>
                                    Livraison +<%= data.offers[i].shipping %> €
                                <% } else { %>
                                    Livraison gratuite
                                <% } %>
                            </span>
                        </div>
                        <div class="ln__price__offers__stock">
                            <% if (data.offers[i].stockStatus) { %>
                                <span class="ln__icon ln__icon-check"></span>
                            <% } else { %>
                                <span class="ln__icon ln__icon-close"></span>
                            <% } %>
                        </div>
                        <div class="ln__price__offers__price">
                            <%= data.offers[i].total %> €
                            <br/>
                            <% if (data.offers[i].hasShippingInfo && data.offers[i].shipping > 0) { %>
                                <span class="ln__price__offers__price__without-fees">
                                    <%= data.offers[i].price %> €
                                </span>
                            <% } %>
                        </div>
                        <div class="ln__price__offers__see">
                            <div>
                                <span class="ln__price__cta__sm">Voir</span>
                                <span class="ln__price__cta__md">l'offre </span>
                                <span class="ln__icon ln__icon-arrow-md-right"></span>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </a>
                </li>
                <% } %>
            </ul>
            <% if (data.offers.length > 6) { %>

        <script type="text/template" id="price-table-tpl">
    <div class="ln__price<% if (data.hasTabs) { %> ln__price--tabs<% } %>">
        <% if (data.hasTabs) { %>
            <ul class="ln__price__tabs">
                <% for (var i = 0; i < data.tabs.length; i++) { %>
                    <% if (data.labels.hasOwnProperty(data.tabs[i])) { %>
                        <li<% if (i === 0) { %> class="ln__price__tab__active js-tab-active"<% } %>>
                            <a href="#" data-price-id="<%= data.tabs[i] %>" class="js-tab-link">
                            <%= data.labels[data.tabs[i]] %>
                            </a>
                        </li>
                    <% } %>
                <% } %>
                <li>
                    <a href="#" class="js-more-tabs">+</a>
                </li>
            </ul>
            <ul class="ln__price__more__tabs js-more-tabs-container hidden"></ul>
        <% } %>
        <div class="ln__price__offers<% if (data.hasTabs) { %> ln__price__offers--tabs<% } %> js-price-offers">
            <div class="ln__price__head"></div>
            <ul>
                <% for (var i = 0; i < data.offers.length; i++) { %>
                <li<% if (i === 0) { %> class="ln__price__offers__item--is-highlight"<% } %><% if (i > 5) { %> class="hidden"<% } %>>
                    <a href="<%= data.offers[i].trackingUrl %>"
                       target="_blank"
                       title="<%= data.offers[i].productName %>"
                       class="js-price-lead js-track-price-url"
                       data-track-action="<%= data.offers[i].merchantName %>"
                       data-track-label="<%= data.productName %>"
                       rel="nofollow"
                    >
                        <div class="ln__price__offers__merchant">
                            <img src="<%= data.offers[i].merchantIcon %>" width="16" height="16" alt="" />
                            <%= data.offers[i].merchantName %>
                            <br />
                            <span class="ln__price__offers__merchant__shipping">
                                <% if (!data.offers[i].hasShippingInfo) { %>
                                    Livraison NC
                                <% } else if (parseFloat(data.offers[i].shipping.replace(',', '.')) > 0) { %>
                                    Livraison +<%= data.offers[i].shipping %> €
                                <% } else { %>
                                    Livraison gratuite
                                <% } %>
                            </span>
                        </div>
                        <div class="ln__price__offers__stock">
                            <% if (data.offers[i].stockStatus) { %>
                                <span class="ln__icon ln__icon-check"></span>
                            <% } else { %>
                                <span class="ln__icon ln__icon-close"></span>
                            <% } %>
                        </div>
                        <div class="ln__price__offers__price">
                            <%= data.offers[i].total %> €
                            <br/>
                            <% if (data.offers[i].hasShippingInfo && data.offers[i].shipping > 0) { %>
                                <span class="ln__price__offers__price__without-fees">
                                    <%= data.offers[i].price %> €
                                </span>
                            <% } %>
                        </div>
                        <div class="ln__price__offers__see">
                            <div>
                                <span class="ln__price__cta__sm">Voir</span>
                                <span class="ln__price__cta__md">l'offre </span>
                                <span class="ln__icon ln__icon-arrow-md-right"></span>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </a>
                </li>
                <% } %>
            </ul>
            <% if (data.offers.length > 6) { %>
                <a href="#" class="js-prices-more ln__price__more">Voir plus d'offres <span class="ln__icon ln__icon-arrow-md-bottom"></span></a>
                <a href="#" class="js-prices-more ln__price__more hidden">Voir moins d'offres <span class="ln__icon ln__icon-arrow-md-top"></span></a>
            <% } %>
        </div>
    </div>
</script>

    <div class="ln__price<% if (data.hasTabs) { %> ln__price--tabs<% } %>">
        <% if (data.hasTabs) { %>
            <ul class="ln__price__tabs">
                <% for (var i = 0; i < data.tabs.length; i++) { %>
                    <% if (data.labels.hasOwnProperty(data.tabs[i])) { %>
                        <li<% if (i === 0) { %> class="ln__price__tab__active js-tab-active"<% } %>>
                            <a href="#" data-price-id="<%= data.tabs[i] %>" class="js-tab-link">
                            <%= data.labels[data.tabs[i]] %>
                            </a>
                        </li>
                    <% } %>
                <% } %>
                <li>
                    <a href="#" class="js-more-tabs">+</a>
                </li>
            </ul>
            <ul class="ln__price__more__tabs js-more-tabs-container hidden"></ul>
        <% } %>
        <div class="ln__price__offers<% if (data.hasTabs) { %> ln__price__offers--tabs<% } %> js-price-offers">
            <div class="ln__price__head"></div>
            <ul>
                <% for (var i = 0; i < data.offers.length; i++) { %>
                <li<% if (i === 0) { %> class="ln__price__offers__item--is-highlight"<% } %><% if (i > 5) { %> class="hidden"<% } %>>
                    <a href="<%= data.offers[i].trackingUrl %>"
                       target="_blank"
                       title="<%= data.offers[i].productName %>"
                       class="js-price-lead js-track-price-url"
                       data-track-action="<%= data.offers[i].merchantName %>"
                       data-track-label="<%= data.productName %>"
                       rel="nofollow"
                    >
                        <div class="ln__price__offers__merchant">
                            <img src="<%= data.offers[i].merchantIcon %>" width="16" height="16" alt="" />
                            <%= data.offers[i].merchantName %>
                            <br />
                            <span class="ln__price__offers__merchant__shipping">
                                <% if (!data.offers[i].hasShippingInfo) { %>
                                    Livraison NC
                                <% } else if (parseFloat(data.offers[i].shipping.replace(',', '.')) > 0) { %>
                                    Livraison +<%= data.offers[i].shipping %> €
                                <% } else { %>
                                    Livraison gratuite
                                <% } %>
                            </span>
                        </div>
                        <div class="ln__price__offers__stock">
                            <% if (data.offers[i].stockStatus) { %>
                                <span class="ln__icon ln__icon-check"></span>
                            <% } else { %>
                                <span class="ln__icon ln__icon-close"></span>
                            <% } %>
                        </div>
                        <div class="ln__price__offers__price">
                            <%= data.offers[i].total %> €
                            <br/>
                            <% if (data.offers[i].hasShippingInfo && data.offers[i].shipping > 0) { %>
                                <span class="ln__price__offers__price__without-fees">
                                    <%= data.offers[i].price %> €
                                </span>
                            <% } %>
                        </div>
                        <div class="ln__price__offers__see">
                            <div>
                                <span class="ln__price__cta__sm">Voir</span>
                                <span class="ln__price__cta__md">l'offre </span>
                                <span class="ln__icon ln__icon-arrow-md-right"></span>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </a>
                </li>
                <% } %>
            </ul>

        <script type="text/template" id="price-table-tpl">
    <div class="ln__price<% if (data.hasTabs) { %> ln__price--tabs<% } %>">
        <% if (data.hasTabs) { %>
            <ul class="ln__price__tabs">
                <% for (var i = 0; i < data.tabs.length; i++) { %>
                    <% if (data.labels.hasOwnProperty(data.tabs[i])) { %>
                        <li<% if (i === 0) { %> class="ln__price__tab__active js-tab-active"<% } %>>
                            <a href="#" data-price-id="<%= data.tabs[i] %>" class="js-tab-link">
                            <%= data.labels[data.tabs[i]] %>
                            </a>
                        </li>
                    <% } %>
                <% } %>
                <li>
                    <a href="#" class="js-more-tabs">+</a>
                </li>
            </ul>
            <ul class="ln__price__more__tabs js-more-tabs-container hidden"></ul>
        <% } %>
        <div class="ln__price__offers<% if (data.hasTabs) { %> ln__price__offers--tabs<% } %> js-price-offers">
            <div class="ln__price__head"></div>
            <ul>
                <% for (var i = 0; i < data.offers.length; i++) { %>
                <li<% if (i === 0) { %> class="ln__price__offers__item--is-highlight"<% } %><% if (i > 5) { %> class="hidden"<% } %>>
                    <a href="<%= data.offers[i].trackingUrl %>"
                       target="_blank"
                       title="<%= data.offers[i].productName %>"
                       class="js-price-lead js-track-price-url"
                       data-track-action="<%= data.offers[i].merchantName %>"
                       data-track-label="<%= data.productName %>"
                       rel="nofollow"
                    >
                        <div class="ln__price__offers__merchant">
                            <img src="<%= data.offers[i].merchantIcon %>" width="16" height="16" alt="" />
                            <%= data.offers[i].merchantName %>
                            <br />
                            <span class="ln__price__offers__merchant__shipping">
                                <% if (!data.offers[i].hasShippingInfo) { %>
                                    Livraison NC
                                <% } else if (parseFloat(data.offers[i].shipping.replace(',', '.')) > 0) { %>
                                    Livraison +<%= data.offers[i].shipping %> €
                                <% } else { %>
                                    Livraison gratuite
                                <% } %>
                            </span>
                        </div>
                        <div class="ln__price__offers__stock">
                            <% if (data.offers[i].stockStatus) { %>
                                <span class="ln__icon ln__icon-check"></span>
                            <% } else { %>
                                <span class="ln__icon ln__icon-close"></span>
                            <% } %>
                        </div>
                        <div class="ln__price__offers__price">
                            <%= data.offers[i].total %> €
                            <br/>
                            <% if (data.offers[i].hasShippingInfo && data.offers[i].shipping > 0) { %>
                                <span class="ln__price__offers__price__without-fees">
                                    <%= data.offers[i].price %> €
                                </span>
                            <% } %>
                        </div>
                        <div class="ln__price__offers__see">
                            <div>
                                <span class="ln__price__cta__sm">Voir</span>
                                <span class="ln__price__cta__md">l'offre </span>
                                <span class="ln__icon ln__icon-arrow-md-right"></span>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </a>
                </li>
                <% } %>
            </ul>
            <% if (data.offers.length > 6) { %>
                <a href="#" class="js-prices-more ln__price__more">Voir plus d'offres <span class="ln__icon ln__icon-arrow-md-bottom"></span></a>
                <a href="#" class="js-prices-more ln__price__more hidden">Voir moins d'offres <span class="ln__icon ln__icon-arrow-md-top"></span></a>
            <% } %>
        </div>
    </div>
</script>

        <script type="text/template" id="price-table-tpl">
    <div class="ln__price<% if (data.hasTabs) { %> ln__price--tabs<% } %>">
        <% if (data.hasTabs) { %>
            <ul class="ln__price__tabs">
                <% for (var i = 0; i < data.tabs.length; i++) { %>
                    <% if (data.labels.hasOwnProperty(data.tabs[i])) { %>
                        <li<% if (i === 0) { %> class="ln__price__tab__active js-tab-active"<% } %>>
                            <a href="#" data-price-id="<%= data.tabs[i] %>" class="js-tab-link">
                            <%= data.labels[data.tabs[i]] %>
                            </a>
                        </li>
                    <% } %>
                <% } %>
                <li>
                    <a href="#" class="js-more-tabs">+</a>
                </li>
            </ul>
            <ul class="ln__price__more__tabs js-more-tabs-container hidden"></ul>
        <% } %>
        <div class="ln__price__offers<% if (data.hasTabs) { %> ln__price__offers--tabs<% } %> js-price-offers">
            <div class="ln__price__head"></div>
            <ul>
                <% for (var i = 0; i < data.offers.length; i++) { %>
                <li<% if (i === 0) { %> class="ln__price__offers__item--is-highlight"<% } %><% if (i > 5) { %> class="hidden"<% } %>>
                    <a href="<%= data.offers[i].trackingUrl %>"
                       target="_blank"
                       title="<%= data.offers[i].productName %>"
                       class="js-price-lead js-track-price-url"
                       data-track-action="<%= data.offers[i].merchantName %>"
                       data-track-label="<%= data.productName %>"
                       rel="nofollow"
                    >
                        <div class="ln__price__offers__merchant">
                            <img src="<%= data.offers[i].merchantIcon %>" width="16" height="16" alt="" />
                            <%= data.offers[i].merchantName %>
                            <br />
                            <span class="ln__price__offers__merchant__shipping">
                                <% if (!data.offers[i].hasShippingInfo) { %>
                                    Livraison NC
                                <% } else if (parseFloat(data.offers[i].shipping.replace(',', '.')) > 0) { %>
                                    Livraison +<%= data.offers[i].shipping %> €
                                <% } else { %>
                                    Livraison gratuite
                                <% } %>
                            </span>
                        </div>
                        <div class="ln__price__offers__stock">
                            <% if (data.offers[i].stockStatus) { %>
                                <span class="ln__icon ln__icon-check"></span>
                            <% } else { %>
                                <span class="ln__icon ln__icon-close"></span>
                            <% } %>
                        </div>
                        <div class="ln__price__offers__price">
                            <%= data.offers[i].total %> €
                            <br/>
                            <% if (data.offers[i].hasShippingInfo && data.offers[i].shipping > 0) { %>
                                <span class="ln__price__offers__price__without-fees">
                                    <%= data.offers[i].price %> €
                                </span>
                            <% } %>
                        </div>
                        <div class="ln__price__offers__see">
                            <div>
                                <span class="ln__price__cta__sm">Voir</span>
                                <span class="ln__price__cta__md">l'offre </span>
                                <span class="ln__icon ln__icon-arrow-md-right"></span>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </a>
                </li>
                <% } %>
            </ul>
            <% if (data.offers.length > 6) { %>
                <a href="#" class="js-prices-more ln__price__more">Voir plus d'offres <span class="ln__icon ln__icon-arrow-md-bottom"></span></a>
                <a href="#" class="js-prices-more ln__price__more hidden">Voir moins d'offres <span class="ln__icon ln__icon-arrow-md-top"></span></a>
            <% } %>
        </div>
    </div>
</script>
